provenance: real ESA Anomaly Dataset (ESA-ADB) Mission1 lightweight channels 41-46 (Zenodo 12528696, CC BY 3.0 IGO). Missions are anonymised Mission1/2/3 -- they are not named Sentinel anything. Resampled to 60s and z-scored exactly as the training script does. These are the windows satellite_comms.telemanom was trained on, unlike the NASA SMAP/MSL sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline.

input.layout: samples[i] is 250 timesteps x 6 channels, row-major, already resampled and z-scored

expected.note: Mean absolute error of the next-step forecast, measured here with onnxruntime on exactly these windows. persistence_mae is what predicting no change would score, so a reader can tell whether the model is doing anything.
